title: Brave Search Tools
summary: This module provides tools for integrating with the Brave Search API, enabling agents to perform web searches and retrieve local Points of Interest. It includes a base class for common API interaction logic and specific tools for different search types.

nodes.label: Brave Search Base Tool
nodes.title: Abstract Base for Brave Search Tools
nodes.description: Provides foundational logic for interacting with the Brave Search API, including API key management, rate limiting, and abstract methods for request/response refinement.

nodes.label: Search Local POIs
nodes.title: Brave Local POIs Search Tool
nodes.description: A specialized tool that uses the Brave Search API to find local Points of Interest (POIs) based on user queries, returning structured JSON data.

nodes.label: Perform Web Search
nodes.title: Brave General Web Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables general web searches through the Brave Search API, providing structured results for web pages, with options for filtering and result count.

nodes.label: Brave Search API
nodes.title: External Brave Search Service
nodes.description: The external API endpoint provided by Brave Search, which processes search queries and returns various types of search results.

nodes.label: Brave Search Schemas
nodes.title: Request & Header Validation Schemas
nodes.description: Pydantic models defining the structure and validation rules for request parameters and HTTP headers used across different Brave Search tools.

nodes.label: Environment Variables
nodes.title: API Key Configuration
nodes.description: External environment variables used to securely store and retrieve the necessary API keys for authenticating with the Brave Search API.

nodes.label: Local File Storage
nodes.title: Optional Search Result Storage
nodes.description: A mechanism to optionally save the raw or refined JSON output of Brave Search queries to a local file for debugging or further processing.

groups.label: Brave Search Tools
groups.title: Core Brave Search Functionality
groups.description: Contains the base class and concrete implementations for interacting with the Brave Search API for various search types.

groups.label: Data Validation
groups.title: Schema-based Data Validation
groups.description: Handles the definition and validation of input parameters and HTTP headers using Pydantic schemas to ensure correct API requests.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Services and Configuration
groups.description: Represents external systems and configurations that the Brave Search tools rely on, such as the Brave Search API, environment variables for API keys, and local file storage.
